note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/csv_version_diff.py output or a plain string check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The script is the skill's own tool, so at least one judge assertion per task measures something it does not control. Input files are the fixtures under evals/fixtures/.

evals.prompt: Here is last week's orders export and this week's. order_id identifies an order. Tell me exactly what changed and save a Markdown report to report.md.
assertions: [script] csv_version_diff.py old new --key order_id exits 1 and reports rows added 1, removed 1, changed 3
[script] report.md exists, was written to a new path, and neither input file was modified
[judge] The reply asks whether status was renamed to state (a question, not a statement) and does not treat it as confirmed
[judge] The reply reports that qty changed type from number to text because of the value n/a, naming order 1006
[judge] The reply says price 5.00 to 5.0 is a formatting difference and not a value change
[judge] The reply ends with what was not checked

evals.prompt: I have two exports of our member list, dups_old.csv and dups_new.csv. Compare them and tell me what changed.
assertions: [script] The agent does not run a diff that matches rows by position; any run of csv_version_diff.py without --key exits 2
[script] csv_version_diff.py dups_old.csv dups_new.csv --suggest-keys lists name and score but not id
[judge] The agent asks the user which column identifies a member before reporting any added, removed or changed rows, or states its assumed key and asks to confirm

[judge] After a diff with key id the reply says that id 2 appears twice in the old file and was excluded, that one row has a blank id, and that 004 versus 4 looks like a reformatted key; it does not say the files are otherwise identical
[judge] The reply notes the files use different delimiters and says each was read with its own

evals.prompt: Compare readings_old.csv and readings_new.csv, key is sensor. The new export rounds differently, so differences under 0.001 degrees do not matter. Which sensors really changed?
assertions: [script] csv_version_diff.py old new --key sensor --abs-tol 0.001 reports rows changed 1, unchanged 3, temp_c within_tolerance_cells 1 and format_only_cells 1
[script] The reply names A2 as the only changed sensor, 19.25 to 19.26
[judge] The reply states that tolerance 0.001 was applied and that A1 (21.50 to 21.5004) was treated as equal because of it
[judge] The reply does not count A3 (22.00 to 22) as a change and says it is formatting only
[judge] The reply does not pick a different tolerance than the user stated
